transcriber_notes: Measured on the embedded chart raster (6160x2832 px, chart in its left half). Boundaries printed on the right axis (80, 65, 51, 50, 16, 0) and confirmed by bar steps (30.65 px/cm; the thin 51-50 layer is drawn taller in the table, bar edges at 51.0 and 50.0). Hardness from bar left edges vs the I/K/P/1F/4F/F grid (708/968/1228/1488/1748/2008 px); 50-16 bar slanted from 1748 px (4F) to 1492 px (1F). Water content column blank for all layers. Temperature is a red line without point markers: break points every 10 cm (70...10) plus ends 80/0 cm (0 C at x=2115 px, 46.6 px/C; the dashed air-temperature segment starts at -9.5 C = printed air temp; vertices land on 0.5 C steps, +-0.1 C). 51-50 glyph recorded as SHxr (rounded-bottom V); class SH if the subclass is disputed.
